title: Commanders to play "good amount" of starters Saturday, but unsure on Jayden Daniels

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Commanders to play "good amount" of starters Saturday, but unsure on Jayden Daniels
sources.description: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn shared some plans for Saturday's game against the Lions during a Thursday morning press conference, but the status of quarterback Jayden Daniels remains up in the air.
